foundation.--jk-shadow-control: 7px 9px 18px color-mix(in oklab, #332b3e 16%, transparent), inset 2px 2px 0 color-mix(in oklab, white 78%, transparent), inset -3px -4px 8px color-mix(in oklab, #332b3e 7%, transparent)

colorUsage.primary: Coral #ff826e action surface; always pair with --jk-primary-foreground. Light mode uses deep plum #332b3e on coral.
colorUsage.inlineLinks: Use --jk-foreground with underline; primary is not a universal link-text color.
colorUsage.muted: Use --jk-muted-foreground for secondary text on background, card, or muted. Canvas is warm cream #fff8f0; lavender #b7a3ed, mint #a8dcc4, and butter #f6d978 are supporting clay colors, not body text.
colorUsage.border: Raised clay uses the offset shadow in --jk-shadow-control. Use --jk-input when a field needs a visible boundary; --jk-border is only a subtle divider.
colorUsage.status: Done, next, and not-started need a word and an icon as well as color. Pair destructive, success, and warning with their foregrounds. Butter #f6d978 is the warning surface with plum text.
colorUsage.charts: Use all five chart colors with labels or other redundant encodings; review adjacency in the rendered chart. Chart hues follow coral, mint, butter, lavender, and plum.
